resolution.rationale: The official Carabinieri communication describes a precautionary operation and the continuation of a wider investigation. The execution date and operation geography are procedural, while the underlying alleged acts vary in date, place and legal character. Creating an ARTEMIS II EVENT would collapse multiple occurrences and procedural actions into a false incident.

allowed_downstream_use: source for EVENT_CLUSTER where underlying acts remain unresolved
prohibited_downstream_use: single crime-map marker for Artemis II
using arrest/seizure geography as occurrence geography
using 2026-06-18 as occurrence date for underlying acts
next_action: Extract only occurrence-level claims that contain enough distinguishing time/place evidence; keep unresolved multiplicity clustered.
